incident.user_authorized: 允许无状态测试 1 张
incident.incorrect_action: The controller/main chat directly invoked ChatGPT Images instead of only recording authorization and instructing a fresh stateless generator chat.

root_cause: Control-plane authorization and generator-plane execution were conflated in the same conversation.
hard_guard: The VPD controller/main chat MUST NEVER call image generation.
Authorization messages in the controller chat may only update task state and return the fresh-chat ticket.
Only a fresh stateless generator chat whose first user message is the frozen ticket may call ChatGPT Images.
The generator chat must not read GitHub/project state before generation.
After generation the generator chat must upload raw PNG to Google Drive and return the stable Drive URL/file ID.
If any controller chat accidentally generates an image, that image is invalid operator output and does not consume the user's authorized formal/smoke budget.
